_about: Which time past a warning it is read, for warnings on roads the ride uses both ways. Default: every pass, except a warning whose name says steep, descent, downhill or hill, which is read only where the route goes downhill. Here a warning (by its exact name) can be set to: downhill (only the pass coming down the hill), uphill, first, last or every. Ben, 15/10/2026: the Mt Tinbeerwah intersection warning matters only on the way down, which on the out and back Mt Tinbeerwah ride is the second (last) pass.
